answer: Nectar parent chain: each answer cites the sha-256 nectar digest of the prior accepted answer and posts a 200 POA bond. At the epoch summit, a jury re-checks citations; a wrong nectar slashes half the bond (100 POA) and tombstones it. Sable quarantine holds flagged answers until cleared, so a clone cannot reuse one chain across aliases. Steps: post 200 POA per key, cite the prior nectar digest, submit before close; jury samples at summit, slashes bad cites. One hundred clones lock 20,000 POA and lose 100 POA per broken link. A climbing rope: each knot must hold, or the team falls.
